result.title: CriticJEPA: World Models Are Better Critics Than Optimizers
result.summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed planning by predicting action outcomes. Gradient-based planners optimize actions to lower predicted goal cost, but continued optimization can exploit prediction errors after execution stops improving. Comparing plans requires informative relative scores; improving them also requires reliable update directions. Exact-state execution reveals that a frozen hierarchical world model ranks goal-conditioned proposals even when its rankings among outputs of prolonged gradient search are uninformative. Effective planning pairs goal-directed candidates with predictions that distinguish their outcomes. We introduce CriticJEPA, which learns goal-conditioned flow proposals from reward-free trajectories and uses frozen rollouts to select among them at every hierarchy level. Forward selection forms a complete planner; short anchored updates refine candidates before selection. Across visual navigation and manipulation, CriticJEPA increases success at a fraction of the planning compute, transferring shared settings across independently trained models, hierarchy depths, and unseen tasks while keeping every world-model weight fixed.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CriticJEPA：在冻结的分层视觉世界模型上，用无奖励轨迹学习目标条件 flow 提议，并在每一层用冻结 rollout 对候选排序选择，配合短程锚定更新替代长程梯度优化，用于视觉导航与操作。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「生成多个候选、再用冻结预测器作 critic 排序、并以短程更新替代持续优化」的路线，可能与 LVR 中 latent 假设的提议—验证以及 THINK/STOP 的过度优化与停止决策问题相通，可供核查。
